name: Atal Pension Yojana

clauses.text: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old age income security scheme for a savings account holder in the age group of 18-40 years who is not an income tax-payee.
The minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum is 40 years.
From 1st October, 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income tax payer, shall not be eligible to join APY.
KYC details are fetched from active Bank/Post Office Savings account.

documents_required: KYC details fetched from an active Bank/Post Office Savings account
